en.q1v: Taiwan passport: visa-free in the Schengen area, up to 90 days in any 180. Nothing to apply for.
en.q3v: I went in July: two long golden hours a day, but hot and peak crowds. May–June or September buys you gentler heat and thinner queues for the same light.
en.q4v: July sunrise 6:35, sunset 21:25 — the two golden hours sit 15 hours apart, so plan a real break in the middle.
en.q5v: Type C / F, 230V 50Hz — the round two-pin. Taiwan chargers need an adapter.
en.q6v: Taiwan −6 hours in summer. Jet lag works in your favour: you wake early enough for sunrise.
en.tr1c: Metro, bus, funicular and FGC on one card. Bought on trip.com; it paid for itself by day two.
en.tr2c: Skip the harbour cable car — pricey, long queue, and it only reaches mid-hill.
en.tr3c: Navigate to Peu del Funicular, not "Tibidabo". Avoid the first and last carriage — the platform is too short to get out.
en.tr4c: 08:15 out, 17:45 back, about 3 hours each way.
en.pStay: The Central House Barcelona Gracia — all five nights, no moving. Gràcia is the right call for this itinerary: you are walking distance from Gaudí country, one bus from Park Güell and Bunkers del Carmel, and the neighbourhood still feels lived-in rather than staged for tourists. Coming back at 22:00 after a 21:25 sunset and finding dinner still being served is worth more than a sea view.
en.pActs: What I booked, what I skipped, and what it actually cost. Prices are what I paid in TWD — book the timed ones before you fly, they sell out.
en.a1note: Worth every cent. Book early afternoon and stay for the 3 pm light.
en.a2note: Go for the rooftop chimneys. Morning slot beats the crowds.
en.a3note: Timed entry — and ride one bus stop past, so you walk downhill.
en.a4note: The stained-glass skylight alone justifies the ticket.
en.a5note: Facade, cloister and rooftop — quick but worth it.
en.a6note: Covers metro, funicular and FGC. Paid for itself by day two.
en.t4cap: Pay on the day, or free
en.a7note: Cable car stops at 21:00 — for the 21:25 sunset, walk down to the funicular instead.
en.a8note: Summer Wed–Sun — check the schedule, it changes by season.
en.a9note: Breakfast and jamón. Buy at listed prices and you won't get stung.
en.a10note: Five minutes from Sagrada Família and far quieter.
en.a11note: 08:15 out, 17:45 back. Download offline maps and bring some euros.
en.skipLabel: What I skipped — and would skip again
en.skipBody: Casa Batlló — the facade from the street is the shot; the interior ticket is steep. Montserrat — I had the NT$1,721 combo ticket researched, then chose Andorra instead. Montserrat needs a full day and deserves its own trip; don't squeeze it in.
en.pSpots: Eleven spots, ordered roughly as I'd shoot them. Every name links to the exact map pin.
en.s1note: Book a ~13:00 entry and stay — the stained-glass light peaks around 3 pm.
en.s2note: 360° city panorama. Best light at sunset or early morning; near Park Güell.
en.s3note: The "wounded star" towers on the beach — go at sunrise, worth the 5:30 alarm.
en.s4note: Warm brick glows at dusk; the promenade gives clean symmetrical frames.
en.s5note: The Gothic quarter's lace bridge — shoot early before the lane fills.
en.s6note: Timeslot ticket (11:30 worked well); facade + cloister.
en.s7note: The rooftop chimneys are the shot. Morning slot avoids the worst crowds.
en.s8note: Honest verdict: the facade from the street is enough — I skipped the ticket.
en.s9name: "The World Begins With Every Kiss" mural
en.s9note: Mosaic of a kiss made from thousands of tiny photos, near the Cathedral.
en.s10note: Columbus column at the port — pairs with the old-harbour walk.
en.s11note: Church-on-a-mountain above the whole city. Go up before sunset; enter the temple and climb first.
en.tip1body: Don't get off at the Park Güell stop. Ride one more stop and walk back downhill to the entrance — the "correct" stop makes you climb a long uphill. A local taught me this; my legs are grateful.
en.tip2body: Don't navigate to "Tibidabo" — navigate to Peu del Funicular station. On the S1/S2 train, avoid the first and last carriage or the short platform won't let you off. Then: Vallvidrera funicular (don't exit the station) → bus 111 to the top.
en.tip3label: Montjuïc — take the right cable car
en.tip3body: There are two cable cars. Skip the Port one (expensive, long queue, only reaches mid-hill). Take metro → Funicular → Telefèric de Montjuïc to the castle. It stops at 21:00 — for the 21:25 sunset, stay at Mirador de l'Alcalde, then walk down to the Funicular (runs till 22:00) or catch bus 150.
en.d1h: Casa Milà, Sagrada light, Bunkers sunset
en.d1p: Casa Batlló facade from the street, La Pedrera at 10:30, then Sagrada Família on a 13:00 entry — stay inside until the 3 pm light. Recinte Modernista de Sant Pau after. Sunset from Bunkers del Carmel, then Arc de Triomf by night.
en.d2h: Sunrise at the beach, Gothic quarter, Montjuïc night
en.d2p: Sunrise at L'Estel ferit (6:35). Gothic quarter all morning: La Boqueria for breakfast, Palau de la Música at 10:00, Cathedral at 11:30, Pont del Bisbe, the kiss mural. Port and Mirador de Colom, then Montjuïc by funicular + cable car for the castle and the Mirador de l'Alcalde sunset. Finish at the Magic Fountain show (summer Wed–Sun — check the schedule).
en.d3h: Mosaic mornings, a church above the clouds
en.d3p: Park Güell on a 13:30 timeslot (use the bus trick in the notes below), wander Gràcia, then the whole Tibidabo transport chain for sunset at Sagrat Cor — the city and the sea in one frame.
en.d4p: I took the Flixbus to Andorra (8:15 out, 17:45 back; download offline maps, bring some euros). The alternative I researched and skipped: Montserrat by R5 + rack railway, with the Sant Jeroni summit hike — next time.
en.pEat: The full research list had 20+ places; these are the ones that earned their spot. “Eaten” marks the ones I ate at myself.
en.f1note: Best paella of the trip — a 2-person pan feeds 3; outdoor tables are photogenic.
en.f2note: Hidden gem, low prices — seafood rice and the grilled meat platter.
en.f3note: No misses — order the cod, foie, and shrimp.
en.f4note: Where locals go — foie brioche, spicy potatoes, scallops.
en.f5note: Grab what looks good; they count your toothpicks at the end.
en.f6note: Molten Basque cheesecake — Brie and Classic are the ones.
en.f7note: Old-school: five churros + thick hot chocolate for €5.
en.f8note: Market grazing; for jamón, buy the black-pig label at listed prices.
en.f9note: Century-old institution — Paella Parellada is the signature.
en.f10note: Pick your seafood by weight, they cook it — oysters are the move.
en.p1: Book timeslots ahead (Klook worked for everything): Sagrada Família tower, La Pedrera, Palau de la Música, Cathedral.
en.p2: Hola Barcelona travel card covers metro, funicular and FGC — it paid for itself by day two.
en.p3: July light: sunrise 6:35, sunset ~21:25. Plan dinner reservations after sunset, not before.
en.p4: Casa Batlló: exterior only is a legitimate choice — spend the ticket money on paella.
en.p5: Base: The Central House Barcelona Gracia — walkable to Gaudí country.

zh.q1v: 台灣護照:申根區免簽,180 天內可停留 90 天。不用辦。
zh.q3v: 我去的是七月:一天兩個很長的黃金時刻,但很熱、人也最多。5–6 月或 9 月光線一樣好,熱度和排隊都溫和許多。
zh.q4v: 七月日出 6:35、日落 21:25——兩個黃金時刻相隔 15 小時,中間一定要安排真正的休息。
zh.q5v: C / F 型,230V 50Hz,圓形雙孔。台灣的充電器要帶轉接頭。
zh.q6v: 夏令時間比台灣慢 6 小時。時差反而幫你:自然會早起趕日出。
zh.tr1c: 地鐵、公車、纜索鐵路、FGC 一張搞定。在 trip.com 買的,第二天就回本。
zh.tr2c: 跳過港口那條纜車——貴、排隊久,而且只到半山腰。
zh.tr3b: S1/S2 → 纜索鐵路 → 111 號公車
zh.tr3c: 導航要輸 Peu del Funicular,不是「Tibidabo」。避開第一節和最後一節車廂,月台太短會下不了車。
zh.pStay: The Central House Barcelona Gracia——五個晚上都住這裡,不換飯店。以這條路線來說 Gràcia 區是對的選擇:走路就到高第的地盤、一班公車到奎爾公園和 Bunkers,而且這一區還有生活感,不是為觀光客布置出來的。21:25 看完日落、22:00 回到住處還有晚餐可吃,這件事比海景值錢。
zh.pActs: 我訂了什麼、跳過什麼、實際花多少。價格是我當時付的台幣——有時段的請出發前先訂,會賣完。
zh.a1note: 每一塊錢都值得。訂下午稍早的場次,然後待到三點的光。
zh.a2note: 為了屋頂的煙囪而去。早上場次人最少。
zh.a3note: 時段票——記得多坐一站公車再下車,這樣是走下坡。
zh.a4note: 光是那面彩繪玻璃天窗就值回票價。
zh.a5note: 正面、迴廊、屋頂——很快但值得。
zh.a6note: 涵蓋地鐵、纜索鐵路與 FGC。第二天就回本。
zh.a7note: 纜車 21:00 收班——要拍 21:25 的日落,改走下去搭 Funicular。
zh.a8note: 夏季週三～週日——記得確認場次,會隨季節變動。
zh.a9name: 波蓋利亞市場 La Boqueria
zh.a9note: 早餐和火腿。照標價買就不會被坑。
zh.a10note: 離聖家堂五分鐘,人少很多。
zh.a11note: 08:15 出發、17:45 回程。記得下載離線地圖、帶點歐元。
zh.skipLabel: 我跳過的——而且下次還是會跳過
zh.skipBody: 巴特由之家——街上看立面就是那張照片了,內部門票偏貴。Montserrat 鋸齒山——我把 NT$1,721 的套票都研究好了,最後選擇去安道爾。Montserrat 需要一整天,值得單獨安排一趟,不要硬塞。
zh.pSpots: 十一個機位,大致依拍攝順序排列。每個名稱都連到精確地圖座標。
zh.s1note: 訂 13:00 左右入場然後待著——彩繪玻璃的光線在下午 3 點最美。
zh.s2note: 360° 城市全景。日落或清晨光線最好;離奎爾公園不遠。
zh.s3note: 海灘上的「受傷之星」高塔——日出時分前往,值得 5:30 的鬧鐘。
zh.s4note: 暖色磚牆在黃昏發光;林蔭大道可拍出乾淨的對稱構圖。
zh.s5note: 哥德區的嘆息橋——趁巷子還沒擠滿人早點拍。
zh.s6note: 時段票(11:30 剛剛好);正面與迴廊都值得。
zh.s7note: 屋頂煙囪就是那張照片。早上場次人最少。
zh.s8note: 誠實心得:街上看立面就夠了——門票錢我省下來了。
zh.s9name: 親吻壁畫 El món neix en cada besada
zh.s9note: 由數千張小照片拼成的吻,就在主教座堂附近。
zh.s10note: 港口的哥倫布紀念柱——順路搭配舊港散步。
zh.s11note: 整座城市之上的山頂教堂。日落前上山;聖心堂要進去,先登頂。
zh.tip1body: 不要在 Park Güell 站下車。多坐一站再走下坡回入口——在「正確」的站下車反而要爬一段長上坡。這是當地屋主教的,我的腿很感激。
zh.tip2body: 不要直接導航「Tibidabo」——要導航到 Peu del Funicular 車站。搭 S1/S2 時避開第一節和最後一節車廂,月台太短會下不了車。接著:Vallvidrera 纜車(不要出站)→ 111 號公車上山頂。
zh.tip3body: 這裡有兩條纜車。跳過港口那條(貴、排隊久、只到半山腰)。搭地鐵 → Funicular → Telefèric de Montjuïc 直上城堡。纜車 21:00 收班——想拍 21:25 的日落,就留在 Mirador de l'Alcalde,之後走下去搭 Funicular(開到 22:00)或搭 150 號公車。
zh.d1no: 第 1 天 · Eixample 與高第
zh.d1h: 米拉之家、聖家堂的光、Bunkers 日落
zh.d1p: 街上看巴特由之家立面,10:30 進米拉之家,13:00 入場聖家堂——待到下午 3 點的光。之後去聖保羅醫院。日落上 Bunkers del Carmel,夜晚收在凱旋門。
zh.d2no: 第 2 天 · 從海到山
zh.d2h: 海灘日出、哥德區、Montjuïc 之夜
zh.d2p: L'Estel ferit 日出(6:35)。整個上午在哥德區:波蓋利亞市場吃早餐、10:00 音樂宮、11:30 主教座堂、嘆息橋、親吻壁畫。港口與哥倫布紀念柱,傍晚搭 Funicular + 纜車上 Montjuïc 看城堡與 Mirador de l'Alcalde 日落。最後看魔法噴泉水舞(夏季週三～週日——記得確認場次)。
zh.d3no: 第 3 天 · 奎爾公園與 Tibidabo
zh.d3h: 馬賽克的早晨、雲端上的教堂
zh.d3p: 13:30 場次進奎爾公園(用最後一段的公車訣竅),漫步 Gràcia 區,然後走完整套 Tibidabo 交通接駁,在聖心堂拍日落——城市與海在同一個畫面裡。
zh.d4p: 我搭 Flixbus 去了安道爾(8:15 出發、17:45 回程;記得下載離線地圖、帶點歐元)。研究過但放棄的另一個選項:搭 R5 + 齒軌列車上 Montserrat,健行 Sant Jeroni 最高峰——下次吧。
zh.pEat: 完整研究清單有 20 幾家;這些是真正值得留下的。標示「吃過」的是我親自吃過的。
zh.f1note: 本趟最強海鮮飯——兩人份三人吃剛好;室外座位很出片。
zh.f2note: 隱藏版、人均低——海鮮飯和烤肉拼盤。
zh.f3note: 沒踩雷——必點鱈魚、鵝肝、蝦。
zh.f4note: 本地人愛店——鵝肝布里歐修、辣味土豆、扇貝。
zh.f5note: 看到喜歡就拿,最後數牙籤算錢。
zh.f6note: 流心巴斯克——Brie 和 Classic 最推。
zh.f7note: 老字號:五根油條配濃熱巧克力 €5。
zh.f8note: 市場小吃;買火腿認黑豬標籤、按標價買不踩雷。
zh.f9note: 百年老店——招牌 Paella Parellada。
zh.f10note: 自助秤重選料、現場烹調——生蠔必吃。
zh.p1: 提前訂時段票(Klook 全部搞定):聖家堂塔樓、米拉之家、音樂宮、主教座堂。
zh.p2: Hola Barcelona 交通卡涵蓋地鐵、Funicular 與 FGC——第二天就回本。
zh.p3: 七月光線:日出 6:35、日落約 21:25。晚餐訂位排在日落之後,不是之前。
zh.p4: 巴特由之家:只看外觀完全合理——門票錢拿去吃海鮮飯。
zh.p5: 住宿基地:The Central House Barcelona Gracia——走路就能到高第的地盤。
